what_i_found: An apocalypse runner where failure never ends the run: every collision permanently reduces the number of people alive, and the story adapts to the survivors. The mission changes from lane running through City and Station, with two-second left, middle, and right calls, to analog free flight through two orbital nets. Six successful lane calls protect up to 800 million people before the final switch.
